text: what determines PA compared to candle activity. I see price move into a level but people say there is no PA. WHY? anybody know please explain.

author: Atari
text: In order to have PA, there needs to be an ENGULF of a FL to the left that is important. Without an ENGULF of an important FL there is NO PA. Secondly, the ENGULF must not hit target otherwise, there is no PA either.

author: Edge
text:
Yes quite True Linos. The only thing I would say is that because we do not need PA, the trade off is that we ought to really be looking at the approach and the clean orders we are leaning on. for example, lets use a 2DT example. even without space we can take the trade back to the 2DT kink

BUT

We need to be comfortable with the approach and reaction at our FL we are leaning on, plus they need to contain clean orders. So the trade off here is not having to worry so much about the space (as per diagram - QM has hit target) but we have to be more cautious than we ordinarily would with the approach and reaction.

Over at RTMA last year we had some discussions about scenario analysis which helps in these type of situations
